description: One tab in a Tabs strip, and the panel it shows. Tab draws the button; its content fills the tabpanel Tabs renders beside the tablist.

value.description: What this tab selects, and what the parent's `change` carries.

label.description: What the tab reads. Arena draws the button; the consumer names it.

content.description: What the panel shows while this tab is selected. Tabs places it; Tab never renders it, because a tabpanel may not sit inside a tablist.
